hero.title: Experience India through its people.
hero.titleHi: भारत को लोगों के साथ महसूस कीजिए।
hero.description: Meet local people, join a cooking or craft session, or stay with a family. Everyone is checked by a person. Contact details are shared only when both of you agree.

threeWays.title: Three ways to experience India
threeWays.titleHi: भारत का अनुभव करने के तीन मार्ग
threeWays.way1Desc: Connect with an Indian resident for tea, a neighbourhood walk, or language exchange. This is not a paid service by default and requires no tourism business.
threeWays.way2Desc: Participate in cultural sessions organized by residents, artists, and families. Experiences include cooking, craft traditions, village walks, and music.
threeWays.way3Desc: Eligible hosts offering home hospitality with verification and compliance standards. This feature is not open yet.

howItWorksSection.title: How it works
howItWorksSection.step1Desc: Browse verified local residents, traditional artists, and cultural sessions across Indian districts.
howItWorksSection.step2Desc: Send a connection request with your proposed date and public meeting place. Contact details are revealed only when both sides confirm.
howItWorksSection.step3Desc: Meet safely in a designated public area, learn traditions directly from families, and share honest reviews.

trustSection.title: Trust and community safety
trustSection.desc: Every member is checked by a person. Initial meetups are held in public places, and emergency helplines are available around the clock.

becomeHostSection.title: Share your culture with travellers
becomeHostSection.titleHi: यात्रियों के साथ अपनी संस्कृति साझा करें
becomeHostSection.desc: If you live in India and enjoy welcoming respectful international visitors for conversation, walks, or art demonstrations, join our local community.
